title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計~Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design
focus: 以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌~Tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse
summary: 從 Ronan Point、世界貿易中心 7 號大樓與 Champlain Towers South 的教訓出發，建立異常荷載的風險觀念與拆柱後的荷載重分配，學習拉結力法、板柱穿孔剪力與完整性鋼筋、懸鏈作用與接頭轉角，再談施工符合性、子結構試驗與能量法、既有建築腐蝕評估、火災熱膨脹觸發的倒塌，以及使用期間的荷載變更管理與交接。~Starting from the lessons of Ronan Point, World Trade Center 7 and Champlain Towers South, build the risk view of abnormal loads and the load redistribution after column loss, learn the tie-force method, slab–column punching shear and integrity reinforcement, catenary action and connection rotation, then cover construction conformance, subassembly tests and the energy method, corrosion assessment of existing buildings, fire-triggered collapse through thermal expansion, and load-change management and handover in service.

units.anchor: 局部破壞範圍~Extent of local damage
units.title: 異常荷載與不成比例倒塌~Abnormal loads and disproportionate collapse
units.mechanism: 連鎖倒塌（不成比例倒塌）是指一個局部破壞，例如一根柱或一片承重牆因爆炸、撞擊、火災或施工錯誤失效，沿著荷載路徑擴散，最後造成與起因不成比例的大範圍倒塌。1968 年倫敦 22 層預鑄大板住宅 Ronan Point 在 18 樓角落發生瓦斯爆炸，吹出一片承重牆，上方樓層失去支承後連續塌落，促成英國建築法規加入不成比例倒塌條文。設計目標不是讓結構在任何事件中毫髮無傷，而是把損壞限制在可接受範圍，例如 Eurocode 以樓層面積 15% 或 100 m² 取小者為限。~Progressive or disproportionate collapse occurs when local damage, such as a column or load-bearing wall lost to explosion, impact, fire or construction error, spreads along the load path until the collapse is out of proportion to its cause. In 1968 a gas explosion in a corner flat on the 18th floor of Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block in London, blew out a load-bearing wall, and the floors above, having lost support, fell in sequence; the event led UK building regulations to adopt disproportionate-collapse provisions. The design goal is not to survive every event unscathed but to confine damage to an acceptable extent, for example the Eurocode limit of 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller.
units.model: 以常見的風險分解 P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D)。取異常事件年發生率 P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴、事件造成局部破壞的機率 P(D|H) = 0.5、局部破壞後倒塌的機率 P(C|D) = 0.2，P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵/年；以替代路徑設計把 P(C|D) 降到 0.01，P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷/年，降低 20 倍。數值為教學假設。~A common risk decomposition is P(C) = P(H)·P(D|H)·P(C|D). With an annual abnormal-event rate P(H) = 1×10⁻⁴, a probability of local damage P(D|H) = 0.5 and a probability of collapse given local damage P(C|D) = 0.2, P(C) = 1×10⁻⁵ per year; designing alternate paths that cut P(C|D) to 0.01 gives P(C) = 5×10⁻⁷ per year, 20 times lower. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計初期與業主確認建築的風險類別或後果等級，例如 UFC 4-023-03 的 RC I 至 RC IV，據以決定採用拉結力、替代路徑或局部強化的組合；審查時核對每個假設事件與可接受的局部破壞範圍是否寫入設計基準。~Early in design, agree the building's risk or consequence class with the owner, for example RC I to RC IV in UFC 4-023-03, and use it to choose the combination of tie forces, alternate paths and enhanced local resistance; at review, check that every postulated event and the acceptable extent of local damage are written into the design basis.
units.failure: 若只依一般重力與地震規範設計，構件接合只滿足正常傳力方向，一旦承重牆或柱失效，樓板無法改以懸吊或懸臂方式傳力，上方樓層逐層塌落；Ronan Point 的調查即指出樓板與牆板接合未考慮荷載方向改變。~Designing only to ordinary gravity and seismic rules leaves connections able to transfer load in the normal direction only; once a wall or column is lost, floors cannot switch to hanging or cantilever action and the storeys above collapse one by one, and the Ronan Point inquiry found that slab-to-wall joints had not considered such load reversal.
units.misconception: 只要結構符合耐震規範，就一定不會發生連鎖倒塌。~A structure that satisfies the seismic code can never suffer progressive collapse.
units.practice: 設計基準書要列出採用的抗連鎖倒塌準則、風險類別、假設移除的構件範圍與允許破壞面積，並由業主、建築師與結構技師共同簽認，避免後續設計變更時被忽略。~The design basis should list the progressive-collapse criteria adopted, the risk class, the assumed removal scenarios and the allowable damage area, signed by owner, architect and structural engineer so that later design changes cannot quietly ignore them.

units.anchor: 移除柱上方雙跨梁~Double-span beam over a removed column
units.title: 拆柱後的荷載重分配與動力放大~Load redistribution and dynamic amplification after column loss
units.mechanism: 替代路徑法假設某一根柱突然消失，檢查上方結構能否把荷載繞到相鄰柱。原本兩跨各自受力的梁變成跨度加倍的單跨梁，支承處負彎矩與跨中正彎矩都大幅增加，原本柱頂的負彎矩區甚至反轉為正彎矩，因此下層鋼筋必須連續。柱是瞬間失效而非緩慢卸載，結構會往下衝過靜力平衡位置；對線彈性系統而言，突然施加的荷載使最大變形約為靜態的兩倍，所以線性靜力分析常需乘上荷載放大係數。~The alternate-path method assumes a column suddenly disappears and checks whether the structure above can route its load to adjacent columns. Two beams that worked as separate spans become one beam of double span, so hogging moments at supports and sagging moments at midspan rise sharply, and the former hogging zone over the lost column reverses into sagging, which is why bottom reinforcement must be continuous. Because the column fails instantly rather than unloading slowly, the structure overshoots its static equilibrium; for a linear elastic system a suddenly applied load produces about twice the static deformation, so linear static analysis usually applies a load increase factor.
units.model: 樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa，8 m 受載寬度的線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m。原跨 8 m 兩端固接時 M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m；拆柱後跨度 16 m，M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m，再乘突加荷載的動力放大 2.0，約 2,970 kN·m，為原值的 8 倍。數值為教學假設。~Floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa, so an 8 m tributary width gives w = 69.6 kN/m. For the original 8 m span with fixed ends, M = wL²/12 ≈ 371 kN·m; after column loss the span is 16 m and M ≈ 69.6×16²/12 ≈ 1,485 kN·m, and with a dynamic amplification of 2.0 for sudden loading about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以線性靜力、非線性靜力或非線性動力程序之一進行拆柱分析，檢查構件與接頭的強度或轉角是否在允收值內；同一模型至少檢查角柱、長向與短向外柱中央及內柱等多個位置，並比較不同程序的結果是否合理。~Carry out column-removal analysis by a linear static, nonlinear static or nonlinear dynamic procedure and check that member and connection strengths or rotations are within acceptance limits; examine several locations in the same model, at least a corner column, columns near the middle of the long and short sides and an interior column, and compare results between procedures for reasonableness.
units.failure: 若只做靜力分析而未計入突然失效的動力效應，需求會被低估約一倍，梁柱接頭在真實事件中先斷裂；若下層鋼筋在柱頂截斷不連續，雙跨梁在原柱位置無法承受反轉的正彎矩，局部破壞直接擴散。~Static analysis without the dynamic effect of sudden loss underestimates demand by about half, so beam–column connections fracture first in a real event; if bottom bars stop short at the column, the double-span beam cannot resist the reversed sagging moment at the lost column and local damage spreads directly.
units.misconception: 柱失效時，上方荷載會慢慢轉移，用靜力分析就足夠。~When a column fails, the load above transfers slowly, so static analysis is enough.
units.practice: 梁與樓板的下層鋼筋應以搭接或續接器穿越柱線連續，並在圖說標示為拆柱情境必要的連續筋，避免施工時被當作一般鋼筋而在柱頂截斷。~Bottom bars in beams and slabs should run continuously through column lines with laps or couplers, and drawings should flag them as continuity bars required for column-loss scenarios so that site crews do not treat them as ordinary bars and stop them at the column.

units.anchor: 內部與周邊拉結筋~Internal and peripheral ties
units.title: 拉結力法與結構連續性~Tie-force method and structural continuity
units.mechanism: 拉結力法是一種間接設計：不必模擬特定事件，而是要求樓板與梁在縱向、橫向、周邊與垂直方向都有足夠的連續受拉鋼筋，使局部失去支承時，樓板能像薄膜或懸鏈一樣把荷載拉回相鄰構件。UFC 4-023-03 以樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L 與跨度決定內部拉結力，並要求承受拉結力的構件能承受 0.20 rad 的轉角。拉結筋的價值在於連續與錨定：一根在柱邊斷開的鋼筋，帳面面積再大也無效。~The tie-force method is an indirect design approach: instead of modelling specific events, it requires enough continuous tension reinforcement in floors and beams in the longitudinal, transverse, peripheral and vertical directions that, when local support is lost, the floor can pull the load back to adjacent members as a membrane or catenary. UFC 4-023-03 sets internal tie forces from the floor load w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L and the span, and requires members carrying ties to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad. The value of a tie lies in continuity and anchorage: a bar cut at the column face is useless however large its area on paper.
units.model: UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁。w_F = 8.7 kN/m²、L₁ = 8 m 時 F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m；取 f_y = 420 MPa 與強度折減 φ = 0.75（教學假設），所需鋼筋 A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m，約為每公尺 3 支 D19（3×287 = 861 mm²）。~UFC 4-023-03 gives the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁. With w_F = 8.7 kN/m² and L₁ = 8 m, F_i = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a strength reduction φ = 0.75 (teaching assumptions), the required steel is A_s = 209,000/(0.75×420) ≈ 663 mm²/m, about three D19 bars per metre (3×287 = 861 mm²).
units.verify: 製作拉結筋路徑圖，逐一檢查每條拉結線從一端錨定到另一端的連續性、搭接長度、續接器等級與在柱或牆內的錨定；施工前由監造比對鋼筋施工圖，澆置前設停止點檢查並拍照存證。~Draw a tie-path plan and check each tie line for continuity from anchorage to anchorage, lap lengths, coupler grade and anchorage in columns or walls; before construction the site supervisor compares it with the rebar shop drawings, and a hold-point inspection with photographs precedes each pour.
units.failure: 預鑄或疊合樓板若只靠支承長度擱置而無拉結筋，下方支承失效時板件會直接滑落；拉結筋若在伸縮縫或後澆帶處未續接，計算上連續的拉結線在現場其實是斷開的。~Precast or composite planks that merely sit on their bearings without ties drop straight off when the support below fails; ties left unspliced at movement joints or pour strips are continuous on paper but broken on site.
units.misconception: 拉結筋只要總面積足夠，在哪裡斷開都沒有關係。~As long as the total tie area is sufficient, it does not matter where the bars are interrupted.
units.practice: 拉結筋的搭接與續接位置應避開預期的高轉角區，並採能發展鋼筋全強度的續接器；設計變更若移動開口或伸縮縫，須重新檢查拉結路徑並經結構技師核可。~Locate tie laps and couplers away from expected high-rotation zones and use couplers that develop the full bar strength; any design change that moves openings or movement joints requires the tie paths to be rechecked and approved by the structural engineer.

units.title: 穿孔剪力與結構完整性鋼筋~Punching shear and structural-integrity reinforcement
units.mechanism: 無梁版的柱頭是連鎖倒塌的弱點：穿孔剪力破壞屬脆性，一旦柱頭周圍的混凝土錐體被剪斷，板失去支承，荷載轉給相鄰柱頭，若它們也接近極限，破壞就沿樓板擴散。NIST 於 2026 年發布的 Champlain Towers South 技術結論指出，崩塌始於 2021 年 6 月初泳池平台下兩處停車場柱的穿孔剪力破壞，荷載重分配給無法承受的相鄰接頭，而原始設計與施工的偏差使安全餘裕從一開始就太小。穿過柱核心的連續下層完整性鋼筋，能在穿孔後把板懸吊在柱上，防止破壞擴散。~Flat-plate column heads are a weak point for progressive collapse: punching shear is brittle, and once the concrete cone around a column is sheared through, the slab loses support and its load passes to neighbouring column heads, which, if also near their limit, spread the failure across the floor. Technical findings released by NIST in 2026 on Champlain Towers South state that the collapse began in early June 2021 with punching shear failures at two garage columns under the pool deck, that load redistributed to adjacent connections unable to carry it, and that deviations in the original design and construction left margins too narrow from the start. Continuous bottom integrity bars passing through the column core can hang the slab on the column after punching and stop the spread.
units.model: 穿孔剪力 V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d。f'c = 28 MPa、方柱 500 mm、有效深度 d = 200 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+200) = 2,800 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,800×200 ≈ 978 kN，φV_c = 0.75×978 ≈ 733 kN。柱距 7.5 m 的受載面積 56.25 m²、因數化荷載 1.2×7.0 + 1.6×2.5 = 12.4 kPa，V_u ≈ 698 kN，需求比約 0.95。數值為教學假設。~Punching capacity V_c = 0.33√f'c·b₀·d. With f'c = 28 MPa, a 500 mm square column and effective depth d = 200 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+200) = 2,800 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,800×200 ≈ 978 kN and φV_c = 0.75×978 ≈ 733 kN. A 7.5 m grid gives a tributary area of 56.25 m² and a factored load of 1.2×7.0 + 1.6×2.5 = 12.4 kPa, so V_u ≈ 698 kN and the demand ratio is about 0.95. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計時檢查每個柱頭的穿孔需求比，並確認穿過柱核心的連續下層筋足以在穿孔後懸吊樓板；既有建築以透地雷達確認鋼筋位置、鑽心取樣確認強度，並檢查柱頭周圍的放射狀或環狀裂縫與板面下陷。~In design, check the punching demand ratio at every column head and confirm that continuous bottom bars through the column core can hang the slab after punching; in existing buildings, locate bars with ground-penetrating radar, confirm strength with cores and look for radial or circumferential cracks and slab sagging around column heads.
units.failure: 柱頭穿孔前常先在板面出現環繞柱的裂縫與下陷，之後突然破壞；若沒有穿過柱的連續下層筋，板會整片滑落並把衝擊荷載加到下一層，形成樓層疊落。~Punching is often preceded by cracks circling the column on the slab surface and local sagging, then fails suddenly; without continuous bottom bars through the column, the slab drops as a whole and adds impact load to the floor below, producing a pancake collapse.
units.misconception: 無梁版的穿孔剪力破壞前，一定會有很大的撓度可以預警。~Punching shear in a flat plate is always preceded by large, warning deflections.
units.practice: 柱頭區不得任意開孔或埋管，泳池、植栽與廣場鋪面等重荷載區要在圖說標示允許附加荷載；需求比偏高的柱頭應加設柱頭版、剪力鋼筋或剪力栓釘，並由結構技師簽認。~Forbid unplanned openings and embedded pipes near column heads, mark the allowable added load on drawings for heavy zones such as pools, planters and plaza paving, and give column heads with high demand ratios drop panels, shear reinforcement or shear studs signed off by the structural engineer.

units.title: 大變形懸鏈作用與接頭轉角~Large-deformation catenary action and connection rotation
units.mechanism: 當梁或樓板在拆柱後下垂到抗彎強度不足以承受荷載時，構件會轉為受拉的懸鏈線，以軸向拉力把荷載掛到相鄰柱上。這需要三個條件：接頭能承受大轉角而不斷裂、構件與接頭能傳遞軸向拉力、相鄰柱與外圍構件能承受向內拉的水平力。梁柱接頭若只設計成傳遞剪力的簡單接頭，螺栓或剪力板常在轉角增加時先撕裂，懸鏈作用根本建立不起來。~When a beam or slab sags after column loss until its flexural strength can no longer carry the load, it turns into a tension catenary that hangs the load from adjacent columns by axial force. This requires three things: connections that sustain large rotations without fracturing, members and connections that transfer axial tension, and adjacent columns and perimeter members that resist the inward horizontal pull. Simple shear connections often tear at their bolts or shear tabs as rotation grows, so catenary action never develops.
units.model: 懸鏈線拉力 T ≈ wL²/(8δ)。w = 69.6 kN/m、拆柱後跨度 L = 16 m，轉角 0.20 rad 時中點下垂 δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m，T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN；8 m 寬的內部拉結筋總強度約 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN，足以承受，但外柱須能抵抗同量級的內拉力。數值為教學假設。~Catenary tension T ≈ wL²/(8δ). With w = 69.6 kN/m and a post-loss span L = 16 m, a rotation of 0.20 rad gives a midspan sag δ = 8×tan0.20 ≈ 1.62 m and T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN; internal ties across an 8 m width provide about 209×8 ≈ 1,670 kN, which suffices, but the perimeter columns must resist an inward pull of the same order. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性靜力或動力分析追蹤接頭轉角與軸力的發展，並與接頭試驗得到的轉角能力比較；外柱與周邊梁另以水平內拉力檢核，必要時加設周邊拉結或水平桁架。~Track connection rotation and axial force with nonlinear static or dynamic analysis and compare them with rotation capacities from connection tests; check perimeter columns and edge beams separately for the inward horizontal pull, adding peripheral ties or horizontal trusses where needed.
units.failure: 接頭轉角能力不足時，懸鏈線在形成前就斷裂，失去最後一道防線；外柱若未檢核內拉力，懸鏈作用會把外柱拉向內側並引起挫屈，使破壞擴大到相鄰跨。~With too little rotation capacity, connections fracture before the catenary forms and the last line of defence is lost; perimeter columns not checked for the inward pull are dragged inwards and buckle, spreading the failure into adjacent bays.
units.misconception: 只要梁的抗彎強度足夠，拆柱後就不需要考慮懸鏈作用。~If the beam has enough bending strength, catenary action need not be considered after column loss.
units.practice: 需要替代路徑的鋼構接頭，應採用經試驗驗證、能在大轉角下傳遞拉力的型式，並在圖說註明不得任意以其他接頭替代；替代方案須提出同等轉角與拉力能力的試驗或分析證明。~Steel connections relied on for alternate paths should be tested types able to carry tension at large rotations, and drawings should forbid substitution; any alternative must be backed by tests or analysis showing equal rotation and tension capacity.

units.anchor: 鋼筋放樣與保護層~Rebar placement and cover
units.title: 施工符合性與安全餘裕~Construction conformance and safety margin
units.mechanism: 抗連鎖倒塌設計常仰賴少數關鍵鋼筋與接頭，施工偏差對它們的影響遠大於一般構件。上層筋被踩低使有效深度變小、拉結筋搭接長度不足、續接器未鎖緊、預鑄接頭灌漿不實，都會讓計算上的替代路徑在現場不存在。NIST 對 Champlain Towers South 的結論同時提到施工與設計圖說不符、使用期間增加的荷載以及長期腐蝕，共同壓縮了本來就不足的餘裕；因此施工階段的停止點檢查，本身就是抗連鎖倒塌設計的一部分。~Progressive-collapse resistance often rests on a few key bars and connections, and construction deviations affect them far more than ordinary members. Top bars trodden down to a smaller effective depth, short tie laps, couplers not tightened and poorly grouted precast joints all mean the calculated alternate path does not exist on site. NIST's findings on Champlain Towers South cite construction that deviated from the drawings, loads added in service and long-term corrosion as jointly eroding margins that were already too small; hold-point inspection during construction is therefore part of progressive-collapse design itself.
units.model: 若柱頭上層筋被踩低 25 mm，有效深度由 200 降為 175 mm：b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm，V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN，φV_c ≈ 619 kN，比原本 733 kN 低約 16%；同樣 V_u = 698 kN 時，需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.13。數值為教學假設。~If top bars at a column head are pushed down 25 mm, effective depth drops from 200 to 175 mm: b₀ = 4×(500+175) = 2,700 mm, V_c = 0.33×5.29×2,700×175 ≈ 825 kN and φV_c ≈ 619 kN, about 16% below the original 733 kN; with the same V_u = 698 kN the demand ratio rises from 0.95 to about 1.13. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置前以鋼筋檢查表逐一檢查柱頭上層筋高度、支撐馬凳間距、拉結筋搭接長度與續接器扭力或標記，量測保護層並拍照；澆置後以鋼筋掃描儀抽查，偏差超過允許值時由設計者評估是否補強。~Before each pour, use a rebar checklist to verify top-bar height at column heads, chair spacing, tie lap lengths and coupler torque or witness marks, and measure and photograph cover; after the pour, spot-check with a cover meter, and have the designer assess strengthening wherever deviations exceed tolerance.
units.failure: 若停止點檢查只看鋼筋數量而不量高度與搭接，現場可能出現數量對、位置錯的情況，結構在正常使用下沒有徵兆，安全餘裕卻已被吃掉，直到加載或劣化疊加時突然破壞。~If hold-point checks count bars but do not measure height or laps, the site can have the right number of bars in the wrong place; the structure shows nothing in normal use while its margin is gone, until added load or deterioration triggers sudden failure.
units.misconception: 鋼筋數量與圖面相同，就代表結構的抗倒塌能力與設計相同。~If the number of bars matches the drawings, collapse resistance matches the design.
units.practice: 施工規範應把柱頭上層筋高度、拉結筋連續性與關鍵接頭列為停止點，由監造與結構技師簽認後才能澆置；竣工圖須記錄所有偏差與處置方式。~The specification should make top-bar height at column heads, tie continuity and key connections hold points that the site supervisor and structural engineer sign before concreting, and as-built drawings must record every deviation and its resolution.

units.anchor: 子結構拆柱試驗~Subassembly column-removal test
units.title: 子結構試驗與能量法動力容量~Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity
units.mechanism: 接頭在大轉角下的拉力與轉角能力很難只靠計算，需要以實尺度梁柱子結構試驗驗證：把中間柱向下推，記錄力—位移曲線、接頭轉角、梁軸力與破壞模式。靜力推覆曲線可用能量法換算為突然拆柱時的動力容量：結構到某位移時吸收的應變能，必須等於重力荷載在該位移所做的功，因此動力容量低於靜力最大值。~The tension and rotation capacity of connections at large rotations is hard to establish by calculation alone and is verified by full-scale beam–column subassembly tests: the middle column is pushed down while the force–displacement curve, connection rotations, beam axial forces and failure mode are recorded. The static push-down curve converts to a dynamic capacity for sudden column loss by the energy method: the strain energy absorbed up to a displacement must equal the work done by gravity load over that displacement, so dynamic capacity is lower than the static peak.
units.model: 簡化雙線性推覆曲線：0.1 m 時 600 kN，0.6 m 時因懸鏈作用升到 900 kN。到 0.6 m 的吸收能量 E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ，動力容量 P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN，只有靜力最大值的 75%。數值為教學假設。~A simplified bilinear push-down curve reaches 600 kN at 0.1 m and, through catenary action, 900 kN at 0.6 m. Energy absorbed to 0.6 m is E = ½×600×0.1 + (600+900)/2×0.5 = 30 + 375 = 405 kJ, so the dynamic capacity is P_d = E/u = 405/0.6 = 675 kN, only 75% of the static peak. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫要包含試體尺寸、加載方式、量測點（柱頂位移、接頭轉角、梁軸力應變）、停止條件與破壞判定；結果與有限元素模型比較，用來校核分析中的接頭模型與允收轉角。~The test plan should specify specimen size, loading method, instrumentation (column-top displacement, connection rotation, beam axial strain), stop criteria and failure definition; compare the results with finite-element models to calibrate the connection models and acceptance rotations used in analysis.
units.failure: 若直接以靜力推覆的最大力判定合格，會高估約三分之一的實際動力容量；試驗若未正確模擬邊界的水平約束，懸鏈作用被高估或低估，都會讓設計失真。~Accepting the static push-down peak directly overstates the real dynamic capacity by about a third; tests that misrepresent horizontal restraint at the boundaries overstate or understate catenary action and distort the design either way.
units.misconception: 靜力推覆試驗得到的最大力，就等於突然拆柱時結構能承受的荷載。~The peak force from a static push-down test equals the load the structure can carry after sudden column loss.
units.practice: 設計採用的接頭轉角能力必須有試驗或公認文獻依據並在計算書中引用；新型接頭應先完成子結構試驗並經審查核可，才可用在需要替代路徑的位置。~Connection rotation capacities used in design must rest on tests or recognised literature cited in the calculations; a new connection type should complete subassembly tests and pass review before being used where alternate paths depend on it.

units.anchor: 既有建築劣化調查~Condition survey of existing building
units.title: 既有建築評估與腐蝕對餘裕的影響~Existing-building assessment and corrosion of margins
units.mechanism: 既有建築的抗倒塌能力會隨時間下降：防水失效使鋼筋腐蝕、混凝土剝落，附加設備與鋪面增加荷載，改裝則移除牆或開孔。Champlain Towers South 約 40 年使用期間的增加荷載與長期腐蝕，都被 NIST 列為壓縮安全餘裕的因素。評估要結合文件回顧、現場調查、非破壞檢測與取樣試驗，找出需求比已接近 1 的柱頭或接頭，再以替代路徑分析決定補強優先順序。~Collapse resistance of existing buildings declines over time: failed waterproofing corrodes reinforcement and spalls concrete, added equipment and paving raise loads, and renovations remove walls or cut openings. NIST lists both the loads added and the long-term corrosion over the roughly 40-year life of Champlain Towers South as factors that eroded its margins. Assessment combines document review, site survey, non-destructive testing and sampling to find column heads or connections whose demand ratio is approaching 1, then uses alternate-path analysis to rank strengthening priorities.
units.model: 直徑 20 mm 鋼筋若每側腐蝕深度 1.5 mm，剩餘直徑 17 mm，面積比 (17/20)² = 0.7225，斷面損失約 28%；若這支鋼筋是穿過柱核心的完整性鋼筋，穿孔後的懸吊能力也同比例下降。數值為教學假設。~A 20 mm bar corroded 1.5 mm on each side retains a 17 mm diameter, an area ratio of (17/20)² = 0.7225 or a loss of about 28%; if it is an integrity bar through the column core, the hanging capacity after punching falls in the same proportion. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依調查計畫以目視、敲擊、半電池電位、氯離子含量與鋼筋掃描找出腐蝕區，鑽心取樣測強度與碳化深度，必要時鑿開確認鋼筋斷面；結果回饋到結構模型，重新計算關鍵接頭的需求比。~Following a survey plan, locate corrosion with visual inspection, hammer sounding, half-cell potential, chloride content and cover scanning, take cores for strength and carbonation depth, and break out concrete where needed to measure bar sections; feed the results back into the structural model and recompute demand ratios at key connections.
units.failure: 若把剝落與滲水視為一般維修而不評估結構影響，腐蝕會持續吃掉關鍵鋼筋的斷面；修復時只補表面砂漿而不處理氯離子污染與防水，腐蝕會在修補邊緣加速，即所謂環狀陽極效應。~Treating spalls and leaks as routine maintenance without structural assessment lets corrosion keep consuming key bar sections; patching surface mortar without dealing with chloride contamination and waterproofing accelerates corrosion at the patch edges, the so-called ring-anode effect.
units.misconception: 混凝土表面裂縫與剝落只是外觀問題，與結構倒塌風險無關。~Surface cracks and spalls in concrete are cosmetic and unrelated to collapse risk.
units.practice: 業主應建立定期結構檢查制度，例如每 10 年由結構技師全面評估，報告須列出優先處理的關鍵構件與期限；發現柱頭裂縫、板面下陷或大面積剝落時，應立即限制使用並通報主管機關。~Owners should set up periodic structural inspections, for example a full assessment by a structural engineer every 10 years, with reports listing priority members and deadlines; cracks at column heads, slab sagging or extensive spalling call for immediate use restrictions and notification of the authority.

units.anchor: 受熱樓板梁與柱座~Heated floor beams and column seat
units.title: 火災引起的連鎖倒塌~Fire-induced progressive collapse
units.mechanism: 火災是常被低估的觸發事件。NIST 對世界貿易中心 7 號大樓的調查指出，這棟 47 層建築因灑水系統水源中斷，下層樓層火災失控約七小時，樓板梁受熱膨脹使第 13 層一根大梁脫離與 79 號柱的接合，樓板逐層塌落使 79 號柱失去側向支撐而挫屈，最後演變成整棟倒塌；NIST 稱這是第一棟主要因不受控火災而倒塌的高樓。教訓是熱膨脹會在長跨樓板與接頭中產生常溫設計沒有考慮的推力與位移。~Fire is an underrated trigger. NIST's investigation of World Trade Center 7 found that in this 47-storey building, with the sprinkler water supply lost, fires on lower floors burned uncontrolled for about seven hours; thermal expansion of floor beams caused a girder on floor 13 to lose its connection to Column 79, cascading floor failures left Column 79 without lateral support until it buckled, and the whole building collapsed, which NIST calls the first known tall building brought down primarily by uncontrolled fire. The lesson is that thermal expansion produces thrusts and displacements in long-span floors and connections that ambient-temperature design never considered.
units.model: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼梁 L = 15 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、平均升溫 ΔT = 400°C 時，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm；若梁端擱置在 150 mm 寬的柱座上而只有部分被螺栓約束，72 mm 的位移已接近擱置長度的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。~Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 15 m steel beam with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ per °C and an average temperature rise of 400°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×15,000×400 = 72 mm; if the beam end sits on a 150 mm seat with only partial bolt restraint, 72 mm approaches half the seating length. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
units.verify: 以結構火災分析（熱傳加結構非線性）檢查長跨樓板在設計火災下的膨脹推力、接頭位移與柱的有效長度，並確認防火被覆與灑水系統的可靠度假設；既有建築則定期檢查防火被覆完整性與灑水水源。~Use structural fire analysis, heat transfer plus nonlinear structural response, to check expansion thrust, connection displacement and column effective length in long-span floors under the design fire, and confirm the reliability assumed for fire protection and sprinklers; in existing buildings, inspect fireproofing integrity and sprinkler water supply periodically.
units.failure: 灑水系統失效而防火被覆又有缺損時，長跨樓板梁膨脹推動大梁，接頭剪斷或大梁脫離柱座，樓板塌落後柱的無支撐長度變成數層，承載力驟降，局部火災演變成整體倒塌。~When sprinklers fail and fireproofing is damaged, expanding long-span floor beams push girders until connections shear or girders walk off their seats; once floors fall, columns become unbraced over several storeys, their capacity collapses and a local fire becomes total collapse.
units.misconception: 防火被覆只要滿足耐火時效，就不需要考慮熱膨脹對接頭的影響。~If fireproofing meets its fire-resistance rating, thermal expansion effects on connections can be ignored.
units.practice: 長跨樓板與關鍵柱的接頭應以結構火災分析檢核熱膨脹與冷卻收縮，柱座擱置長度與螺栓約束要保留餘裕；灑水水源與消防泵的可靠度須納入維護計畫，任何停水都要有補償措施。~Connections of long-span floors and key columns should be checked by structural fire analysis for expansion and cooling contraction, with margin in seat length and bolt restraint; sprinkler supply and fire-pump reliability belong in the maintenance plan, and any shutdown needs compensating measures.

units.title: 使用期間變更管理與交接~Change management in service and handover
units.mechanism: 抗連鎖倒塌能力在交接後最容易被不知情地削弱：增設屋頂設備、廣場鋪面與植栽、拆除隔間牆、在樓板開孔或切斷拉結筋，每一項單看都不大，累積起來卻可能讓關鍵接頭的需求比超過 1。NIST 指出 Champlain Towers South 使用期間包括泳池平台改變在內的增加荷載，進一步壓縮了餘裕。因此交接文件必須清楚標示哪些構件是替代路徑的關鍵、哪些區域的附加荷載有上限，讓管理單位在改裝前知道必須找結構技師。~Collapse resistance is most easily weakened unknowingly after handover: added roof equipment, plaza paving and planters, removed partitions, slab openings or cut ties each look minor, yet together they can push a key connection's demand ratio above 1. NIST notes that loads added during the life of Champlain Towers South, including pool deck modifications, further reduced its margins. Handover documents must therefore show clearly which members are critical to alternate paths and which areas have added-load limits, so that managers know to call a structural engineer before renovating.
units.model: 在 56.25 m² 的柱頭受載面積上增加 100 mm 鋪面（22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa），因數化增量 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN，V_u 由約 698 kN 增為約 846 kN，相對 φV_c = 733 kN 的需求比由 0.95 升為約 1.15。數值為教學假設。~Adding 100 mm of paving (22 kN/m³ × 0.10 m = 2.2 kPa) over a 56.25 m² column tributary area adds a factored 1.2×2.2×56.25 ≈ 149 kN, raising V_u from about 698 kN to about 846 kN and the demand ratio against φV_c = 733 kN from 0.95 to about 1.15. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 管理單位建立荷載與改裝登錄簿，任何新增設備、鋪面、開孔或拆牆都先由結構技師對照原設計荷載與關鍵構件圖評估；定期檢查時把登錄簿與現場比對，發現未登錄的變更即追溯評估。~Building managers keep a register of loads and alterations, and every new piece of equipment, paving, opening or wall removal is first assessed by a structural engineer against the design loads and the critical-member plan; periodic inspections compare the register with the site and trigger retrospective assessment of any unrecorded change.
units.failure: 若交接文件只有一般竣工圖而沒有關鍵構件與荷載上限資訊，數十年後的改裝者無從得知某條梁是替代路徑或某柱頭已接近極限，逐次小改變累積成大風險。~If handover provides only ordinary as-built drawings without critical members and load limits, renovators decades later cannot know that a beam forms an alternate path or a column head is near its limit, and small changes accumulate into a large risk.
units.misconception: 建築完工驗收後，結構安全不會因使用期間的小改裝而改變。~Once a building passes completion inspection, small renovations in service cannot change its structural safety.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含抗連鎖倒塌設計基準、關鍵構件與拉結筋位置圖、各區允許附加荷載、檢查週期，以及改裝前須經結構技師核可的規定，並隨產權移轉一併交付。~Handover should include the progressive-collapse design basis, plans of critical members and ties, allowable added loads by area, inspection intervals and the rule that alterations need prior approval by a structural engineer, all passed on with any change of ownership.

example: 設計練習：某鋼筋混凝土構架柱距 8 m，D = 6.0 kPa、L = 3.0 kPa。樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa。拉結力法：F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m，取 f_y = 420 MPa、φ = 0.75，需 A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m。替代路徑：拆除一根內柱後，8 m 受載寬度的梁線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m，跨度由 8 m 變 16 m，固端彎矩由約 371 kN·m 增為約 1,485 kN·m，乘動力放大 2.0 後約 2,970 kN·m，為原值 8 倍，一般梁斷面無法以抗彎承受。改用懸鏈作用：轉角 0.20 rad 時下垂 δ ≈ 1.62 m，拉力 T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN，小於 8 m 寬拉結筋總強度約 1,670 kN，但接頭必須在 0.20 rad 下仍能傳遞拉力，外柱也要承受同量級的內拉力。若跨度 L₁ 改為 10 m（受載寬度仍為 8 m），F_i 增為約 261 kN/m，拆柱後跨度 20 m，懸鏈拉力在相同轉角下約增為 1.25 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a reinforced-concrete frame on an 8 m grid carries D = 6.0 kPa and L = 3.0 kPa, so w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa. Tie-force method: F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m, needing A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m with f_y = 420 MPa and φ = 0.75. Alternate path: after removing an interior column, the beam line load over an 8 m tributary width is w = 69.6 kN/m and the span grows from 8 to 16 m, so the fixed-end moment rises from about 371 to about 1,485 kN·m and, with a dynamic amplification of 2.0, to about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original and beyond what an ordinary beam section can resist in bending. Relying on catenary action instead: at 0.20 rad the sag is δ ≈ 1.62 m and the tension T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN, below the roughly 1,670 kN strength of ties across 8 m, provided the connections still carry tension at 0.20 rad and the perimeter columns resist an inward pull of the same order. If L₁ becomes 10 m with the tributary width kept at 8 m, F_i rises to about 261 kN/m, the post-loss span becomes 20 m and catenary tension at the same rotation grows by about 1.25 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 1968 年倫敦 Ronan Point 角落倒塌後，英國在 1970 年修訂建築法規加入「不成比例倒塌」要求，並在過渡期以 34 kPa 的爆炸壓力作為新建高層住宅的設計值。1995 年奧克拉荷馬市 Murrah 聯邦大樓爆炸與 2001 年世界貿易中心事件之後，美國聯邦總務署與國防部發展替代路徑設計準則，國防部 UFC 4-023-03 於 2009 年發布並持續修訂；NIST 在 2007 年出版 NISTIR 7396 整理抗連鎖倒塌的最佳實務，2008 年完成世界貿易中心 7 號大樓調查，2026 年發布 Champlain Towers South 的技術結論。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~After the 1968 corner collapse at Ronan Point in London, the UK amended its building regulations in 1970 to require resistance to disproportionate collapse, using an interim explosion pressure of 34 kPa for new tall housing blocks. Following the 1995 bombing of the Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City and the 2001 World Trade Center attacks, the US General Services Administration and the Department of Defense developed alternate-path design guidelines, with the Department of Defense issuing UFC 4-023-03 in 2009 and revising it since; NIST published best practices on progressive collapse as NISTIR 7396 in 2007, completed its World Trade Center 7 investigation in 2008 and released technical findings on Champlain Towers South in 2026. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Ronan Point 為 22 層預鑄大板住宅，1968 年 5 月 16 日因 18 樓角落瓦斯爆炸局部倒塌，4 人死亡~Ronan Point, a 22-storey precast large-panel block, partly collapsed on 16 May 1968 after a gas explosion in an 18th-floor corner flat, killing 4
英國 1968 年過渡措施要求 5 層以上新建築能承受 34 kPa 的爆炸壓力~Interim UK measures in 1968 required new buildings over five storeys to resist an explosion pressure of 34 kPa
世界貿易中心 7 號大樓為 47 層，2001 年 9 月 11 日下午約 5 時 21 分在火災約 7 小時後倒塌~World Trade Center 7 had 47 storeys and collapsed at about 5:21 p.m. on 11 September 2001 after roughly 7 hours of fire
NIST 於 2008 年 11 月發布世界貿易中心 7 號大樓最終報告 NCSTAR 1A~NIST issued the World Trade Center 7 final report, NCSTAR 1A, in November 2008
Champlain Towers South 為 1981 年興建的 12 層加頂樓公寓，2021 年 6 月 24 日部分倒塌，98 人罹難~Champlain Towers South, a 12-storey condominium with penthouse built in 1981, partly collapsed on 24 June 2021, killing 98
NIST 指出 Champlain Towers South 的初始破壞是倒塌前約 3 週發生在 2 根停車場柱的穿孔剪力破壞~NIST found that Champlain Towers South began with punching shear failures at 2 garage columns about 3 weeks before the collapse
UFC 4-023-03 內部拉結力 F_i = 3·w_F·L₁，其中 w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L~UFC 4-023-03 sets the internal tie force F_i = 3·w_F·L₁, with w_F = 1.2D + 0.5L
UFC 4-023-03 要求承受拉結力的構件能承受 0.20 rad（約 11.3°）的轉角~UFC 4-023-03 requires members carrying tie forces to sustain a rotation of 0.20 rad (about 11.3°)
Eurocode EN 1991-1-7 以樓層面積 15% 或 100 m² 取小者作為局部破壞上限~Eurocode EN 1991-1-7 limits local damage to 15% of the floor area or 100 m², whichever is smaller

timeline.event: 倫敦 Ronan Point 因瓦斯爆炸發生角落連鎖倒塌~A gas explosion causes the progressive corner collapse of Ronan Point in London
英國建築法規增訂不成比例倒塌要求~UK building regulations add requirements against disproportionate collapse
世界貿易中心 7 號大樓在火災中倒塌，成為火災引起連鎖倒塌的代表案例~World Trade Center 7 collapses in fire, becoming the reference case of fire-induced progressive collapse
NIST 發布世界貿易中心 7 號大樓最終報告，指出熱膨脹導致關鍵柱失效~NIST issues its final report on World Trade Center 7, identifying thermal expansion as the cause of the critical column failure
美國國防部發布 UFC 4-023-03，規定拉結力、替代路徑與局部強化~The US Department of Defense issues UFC 4-023-03 with tie-force, alternate-path and enhanced local resistance rules
Champlain Towers South 部分倒塌，NIST 於 2026 年發布穿孔剪力起始的技術結論~Champlain Towers South partly collapses, and NIST releases technical findings in 2026 identifying punching shear as the initiating failure

codes: UFC 4-023-03 建築物抗連鎖倒塌設計（美國國防部統一設施準則）~UFC 4-023-03 Design of Buildings to Resist Progressive Collapse (US Department of Defense Unified Facilities Criteria)
EN 1991-1-7 Eurocode 1：結構作用—意外作用~EN 1991-1-7 Eurocode 1: Actions on structures — Accidental actions
ASCE/SEI 76-23 建築物與其他結構不成比例倒塌潛勢減緩標準~ASCE/SEI 76-23 Standard for Mitigation of Disproportionate Collapse Potential in Buildings and Other Structures
ACI 318 結構混凝土建築規範（結構完整性鋼筋規定）~ACI 318 Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete (structural integrity reinforcement provisions)

sources.title: NIST：世界貿易中心 7 號大樓調查常見問答
sources.titleEn: NIST: WTC 7 investigation frequently asked questions
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope: 調查機關說明 WTC 7 的樓層數、倒塌時間、火災與熱膨脹導致 79 號柱失效的過程及建議；不含接頭設計細節。
sources.scopeEn: Investigating agency's account of WTC 7 storeys, collapse time, the fire and thermal-expansion sequence that failed Column 79, and recommendations; no connection design details.

sources.title: NIST：Champlain Towers South 部分倒塌技術結論新聞稿
sources.titleEn: NIST: Technical findings on what caused the 2021 Champlain Towers South partial collapse
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope: 說明穿孔剪力起始破壞、設計與施工偏差、增加荷載與腐蝕的影響及倒塌順序；最終報告與建議尚待發布。
sources.scopeEn: Describes the initiating punching shear failure, design and construction deviations, added loads and corrosion, and the collapse sequence; the final report and recommendations are still to come.

sources.title: WBDG：UFC 4-023-03 建築物抗連鎖倒塌設計（2016 年第 3 次修訂）
sources.titleEn: WBDG: UFC 4-023-03 Design of Buildings to Resist Progressive Collapse, Change 3 (2016)
sources.publisher: US Department of Defense via Whole Building Design Guide
sources.scope: 設計準則全文，含風險類別、拉結力公式、0.20 rad 轉角要求與替代路徑程序；課程只引用公式型式。
sources.scopeEn: Full design criteria with risk categories, tie-force equations, the 0.20 rad rotation requirement and alternate-path procedures; the course quotes only the form of the equations.

sources.title: NIST：降低建築物連鎖倒塌潛勢的最佳實務（NISTIR 7396）
sources.titleEn: NIST: Best Practices for Reducing the Potential for Progressive Collapse in Buildings (NISTIR 7396)
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope: 說明風險架構、拉結力、局部抵抗與替代路徑三種方法，以及各國規範回顧與案例。
sources.scopeEn: Describes the risk framework, the tie-force, specific local resistance and alternate-path methods, a review of national standards and case studies.

sources.title: 維基百科：Ronan Point（英文）
sources.scope: Ronan Point 倒塌經過、調查結論與英國法規變更的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Overview of the Ronan Point collapse, inquiry findings and UK regulatory changes, for further reading.
